tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find published Reliance products by task, product name, pipe application, or product family.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return the published overview, technical guide, source notes, specification tables, and documents for one product.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to four published products and expose the dimensions or operating details that still need confirmation.

tools.name: shortlist_products
tools.description: Map a stated task to relevant Reliance product families. This returns enquiry candidates and missing information; it does not approve a model or operating procedure.

tools.name: prepare_technical_enquiry
tools.description: Turn known project facts into a review checklist for Reliance. This tool does not send email or place an order.

tools.name: list_product_families
tools.description: List the published product families and their canonical pages.
